request_text_excerpt: NEW CPRA REQUEST — Records Showing How PRA 25-956 Was Supposedly Satisfied Through PRA 25-1088 The City closed PRA 25-956 and stated that it would be responded to under PRA 25-1088. The current production available under PRA 25-1088 contains only six PDF files. I request all existing records showing: who determined that PRA 25-956 was fully covered by PRA 25-1088; what records responsive specifically to PRA 25-956 were located; which of the six produced PDFs the City contends satisfy PRA 25-956; what custodians, accounts, databases, and repositories were searched; what search terms and date …
